text:
Jess: heads-up — ran into a weird key fallthrough in the sampleapp while demoing onboarding. behaviour seems inconsistent between js and py SDKs. repro below, short and annoying.

Jess: repro (local mac):
```
export REDWOOD_ORG_KEY=org_abc123
export REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY=proj_def456
# start sampleapp (uses sdk to pick key)
node samples/simple.js # or python samples/simple.py
```
Jess: expected: SDK picks PROJECT key when present. actual: js picks ORG, python picks PROJECT. :confused:

Dave: :eyes: do you have the versions? we changed precedence in sdk-core last quarter but maybe sampleapp pinned a transitive dep.

Jess: js sdk v0.8.2 (from package-lock), py sdk 0.8.4 (pip). sampleapp is the quickstart from templates repo (latest).

Priya: hmm that rings a bell — we intentionally flipped fallback for CLI vs SDK to prefer org for single-key installs, but that should be consistent across SDKs. sounds like a parity bug. can you paste the minimal output?

Jess: output from node: "Using API key: org_abc123 (source: REDWOOD_ORG_KEY)"
Jess: output from python: "Using API key: proj_def456 (source: REDWOOD_PROJECT_KEY)"

Alex: likely cause: env var normalization layer in js strips the "PROJECT" suffix incorrectly when package-lock resolves to old env-parser. py uses direct os.getenv so unaffected.

Priya: quick check — can you run `npx envinfo@latest` in the sampleapp dir and paste the env? also do `cat package-lock.json | grep env-parser -n`?

Jess: ran it, env-parser v1.1.0 in node_modules, templates package depends on sdk-core@0.8.2 which still bundles env-parser@1.1.0.

Jess: quick workaround for the demo: unset REDWOOD_ORG_KEY before starting node. but that's not great for onboarding docs.

Dave: ok action items: (1) short-term doc note in sampleapp to prefer explicit REDWOOD_API_KEY to avoid ambiguity, (2) add parity test to sdk-suite that asserts precedence is PROJECT > ORG when both present (or decide the canonical precedence), (3) backport fix to js env normalization to match python behavior.

Priya: agree. also propose we introduce a single canonical env var REDWOOD_API_KEY and deprecate the two older ones with a warning message in the SDKs during init. that avoids future confusion.

Alex: +1 for telemetry event on ambiguous configs so we can see how common this is. add a deprecation warning log in minor release, then a breaking change in 1.0.0.

Jess: I'll open a reproducible mini-repo and attach logs. can we ~1 week for the patch? I need it for an internal demo next Tues.

Dave: timeline sounds fine. Priya can you own the js fix/backport? mark as high for onboarding demos.

Priya: I can. I'll: (a) add a unit to sdk-js that ensures .env normalization prefers PROJECT when present, (b) add a warning if both PROJECT and ORG present, (c) update sampleapp quickstart to suggest REDWOOD_API_KEY as preferred.

Alex: I'll add a telemetry stub in infra that increments when warning fired. keep it opt-out.

Jess: thanks! attaching logs + tiny repro: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repro-key-fallthrough (private)

deploy-bot: Staging build queued for repo repro-key-fallthrough (#12), build id 8432.

Dave: cool — when PRs land, ping #devex and I'll schedule a tiny docs refresh in the quickstart. also let's add a one-line note in the SDK changelog.

Jess: will do. thanks y'all :party_parrot:
